name: tracker
need: Show a row of status cells (uptime by day, the last runs of a job), each state with its own shape and word, and a summary

--ds-tracker-height.description: the row of `.ds-tracker__cells` at md (4px per size step)

--ds-tracker-gap.description: the gap between two cells of a tracker (1px at most in a row under 480px)

labExempt.DS.tracker.create: keys and names only: a cell takes its new state at once
